text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 18, 2024) for 325 Bogert Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (May 7, 2024) for 325 Bogert Avenue, Folder Number 24 136363 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to January 31, 2027 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
